# gate: # The gates of the commit-push stages that are NOT built yet (docs/scripts/commit-push-all.md, "Built and not built"). A run that reaches the stage a
# gate belongs to without the gate being built records ONE deferral GATES_NOT_BUILT naming every row that applies, so the run exits 14 and the commits
# carry `Deferred-Gates: GATES_NOT_BUILT` (constitution 11.4.234 (C): no gate is lost silently; 11.4.201: an unbuilt check is never a pass).
# when: always = the gate belongs to every run; declared_paths = the gate judges the content of a declared change set (applies when one is declared).
# Built a gate? Delete its row in the same change that builds it (the matrix section "14 contract" reads this file). An absent or unreadable list in the
# approved copy is itself a deferral, never a clean run; a row with another `when` is 20 owed_gates_invalid.
